title: Supreme Court seems poised to further undercut the Voting Rights Act
summary: The court's conservative majority could invalidate the section of the Voting Rights Act aimed at ensuring that minority voters are not shut out of the process of drawing new congressional district lines.

title: A veteran state department negotiator unpacks the ceasefire agreement in Gaza
summary: Aaron David Miller, a senior fellow at the Carnegie Endowment for International Peace, attributes the Gaza deal in part to Trump's transactional nature and breaking of traditional diplomatic crockery.
